description: Header file defining the NinjaTargetWriter class responsible for generating Ninja build files for targets in the build system.

classes.name: NinjaTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build files for a specific target.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Generates and writes the Ninja file for a target, returning the build line or subninja command.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the writing process, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetResolvedTargetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ResolvedTargetData instance.

methods.name: SetResolvedTargetData
methods.description: Sets the ResolvedTargetData instance used by the writer.

methods.name: WriteSharedVars
methods.description: Writes shared substitution variables between different tools.

methods.name: WriteCCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables for C compiler and action tools.

methods.name: WriteRustCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables for Rust tools and action tools.

methods.name: WriteInputDepsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Writes dependencies as stamp or phony rules and returns dependency files.

methods.name: WriteStampOrPhonyForTarget
methods.description: Writes a final phony rule for target dependencies.

methods.name: WriteOutput
methods.description: Writes a Ninja output file path to the output stream.

methods.name: WriteOutputs
methods.description: Writes multiple Ninja output file paths.

methods.name: WriteCopyRules
methods.description: Writes copy rules for the target.
